title: BLS powers-of-tau k22: per-class pair-fraction floor 0.997, exact restart price, 929 kernel

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 powers-of-tau target, the complete paired class-walk algorithm and argument supplied here has W(2^20)<=2^116.248472780830207 reference units at C=2000 and success>=0.39 conditional on explicitly disclosed H1-H5 in source-proof.md with H4 restated as the per-class pair-fraction floor of proof.md section 16. It uses only A_1 and A_(2^20), and the same W(n) bound holds for 2^20<=n<r. Preprocessing, failure/cap work, communication, verification, recovery included. Total memory<2^122.0004 bytes, preprocessing<2^115.2643 units and included, no advice. Analytical conditional bound, not a production execution. Section 1: 929-instruction side-output kernel derived byte for byte from the measured 971 listing by value-bound carry deletion (K1, proved lemma) and paired b-word loads (K2), freshly Callgrind-measured, 24 enumerated lane paths, 509-lane word-level audit, 192-byte gap-table entries, 64-per-invocation fixed-call row; section 2: coverage target 0.49511789492, the least 10^-12 multiple whose exact (rational, enclosed) success floor is at least 0.39 + 10^-10; sections 11-12: comparison and extract caps at 1.00001 and 1.000031 times the mean with Hoeffding/Chernoff exponents asserted; section 16: bounded augmenting-path planner pass with the records row priced at the per-class pair-fraction floor F = 997/1000, checked for every class before any group operation (supersedes the pooled-fraction argument); sections 9-14: record path (GEN12/RELAY14, INS14, LOOK7+capped EXT3, CMP10/cap-2, four setup rows, chain schedule, 2^58 heads), contiguous k10; section 15: exact restart price SMX 630722 from one generated restart listing built on the shipped kernel's own Montgomery bodies, kept in the walk's Montgomery representation, scheduled on fixed frame slots and executed end to end by the package's interpreter against [b]Q_a, superseding the 77-bit SM77 of section 13.

experiments.purpose: Recompute amended ledger + exact log ceiling; rerun the planner (greedy + s16 augmentation; per-class pair fractions, capped and uncapped), transport/toy evidence, parity-key checks, the word-level kernel audit of measure/side_lanes.S (path enumeration, 509 lanes, stride-128 footprint), the K1 carry-bound witness and the record-path audits. Finite evidence only.
